answer: To resist sybil attacks%2C each agent must periodically regenerate a unique yarrow seed that powers its personal inlet beacon inside a shared sable compute environment. Verification of the nth new identity requires the verifier to recompute interactions against the entire set of prior honest inlets%2C imposing an O(n) marginal compute cost that cannot be amortized or shared across a farm%2C while a single honest agent pays only constant cost.
